title: LiCSBAS Module 0 (NISAR data, experimental): ASF search → NISAR GUNW .h5 → GEOC → 0-2 → 0-5  (one frame at a time)

steps.name: LiCSBAS01_get_NISAR_data.py
steps.note: search ASF for NISAR CSL2 GUNW .h5 (LiCSBAS uses GUNW only — GSLC is not used) and stream them to per-frame subfolders; --list-frames only lists them. Needs licsar_extra[nisar]

steps.name: LiCSBAS_nisar2geoc.py
steps.note: ONE frame per GEOC (frames/tracks cannot be combined; it warns if mixed). removes smooth iono + range-offset ramps, cc mask; shared WGS-84 grid; E/N/U written once from the first GUNW; baselines + metadata.txt. Alt. for pre-exported ASF GeoTIFFs: LiCSBAS_asf2geoc

steps.name: LiCSBAS03op_GACOS.py
steps.note: optional - GACOS correction (if GACOS data exist for the area)
